title: The Wild Salt Revisited
premise: Jonah Hartwell's harmless trade in bottled memories hides a dangerous gift: he can steal and reshape what people remember, a magic the city of Greyhollow outlawed after the Sundering severed it from the dragon-realm of Vael. When his date, archivist Sera Voss, matches a prophecy written a century ago, Jonah learns he is the last heir of the memory-thieves who broke the covenant between realms—and that the city's beloved Magistrate Corvane engineered the ban to hoard dragon-fire for himself. Hunted by Corvane's truth-sniffers and betrayed by his own mentor, Jonah must gather the scattered covenant-stones, confront the truth that his stolen memories erased his own past, and choose between restoring the realms or preserving the lie that keeps Greyhollow safe. In the end, he reforges the covenant at the cost of his own memories, giving the last dragon-fire freely to both worlds and letting Sera carry his story when he cannot.
about_author: Cyrus Pemberton is the pen name of a former maritime archivist who spent a decade cataloguing salvaged logbooks from wrecked merchant ships. They write fantasy about memory, salt, and the things we bury to survive.

chapters.title: The Charm Seller's Hour
chapters.summary: Jonah sells a widow a memory of her late husband's laugh, then meets Sera Voss for a date that turns strange when she recognizes his craft on sight. POV: Jonah. Emotional beat: wary charm curdling into unease as Sera reveals she studies banned prophecy texts—and one bears his face.

chapters.title: Ink Older Than Sin
chapters.summary: In the archive's sealed stacks, Sera shows Jonah the Century Codex: a prophecy naming 'the thief with no yesterday' as covenant-heir. POV: alternating Jonah and Sera. Emotional beat: fascination tipping into dread as Jonah realizes he has no memories from before age nineteen.

chapters.title: What the Sniffers Smell
chapters.summary: Magistrate Corvane's truth-sniffers raid the archive; Sera burns her notes while Jonah escapes through remembered alleys—memories he doesn't recall stealing. POV: Jonah. Emotional beat: panic hardening into resolve; invisibility was always someone else's design.

chapters.title: The Mentor's Ledger
chapters.summary: Jonah confronts Old Bram, the fence who raised him, and finds a ledger proving Bram sold Jonah's childhood memories to Corvane ten years ago. POV: Jonah. Emotional beat: betrayal and grief; the father-figure becomes the first traitor.

chapters.title: Salt and Covenant-Stones
chapters.summary: Following the Codex to the drowned chapel, Jonah and Sera recover the first covenant-stone and meet Wren, a half-dragon exile who confirms the fire is guttering. POV: Sera. Emotional beat: awe and responsibility; Sera chooses Jonah's doomed cause over her career.

chapters.title: The Gilded Lie
chapters.summary: Corvane publicly unveils a 'new era of safety,' feeding the city comforting false memories while draining dragon-fire beneath the Magistracy. POV: Corvane. Emotional beat: chilling conviction; the villain believes order justifies theft.

chapters.title: Ashes of the Second Stone
chapters.summary: The second stone lies in Bram's vault; retrieving it triggers an ambush where Bram dies shielding Jonah, whispering where Corvane keeps the third. POV: Jonah. Emotional beat: mourning braided with fury; loyalty and truth finally pull in opposite directions.

chapters.title: The Price of Remembering
chapters.summary: Bonding with the stones floods Jonah with his erased past—including the memory that he himself helped break the covenant as a child, coerced by Corvane. POV: Jonah. Emotional beat: self-loathing transmuted into acceptance; he must forgive himself to act.

chapters.title: Dragon-Fire Rising
chapters.summary: Jonah infiltrates the Magistracy, frees the captive last dragon, and battles Corvane atop the spire as the city's false memories begin to burn away. POV: alternating Jonah and Sera. Emotional beat: climax—Corvane offers Jonah his stolen childhood back in exchange for surrender.

chapters.title: The Wild Salt Revisited
chapters.summary: Jonah refuses, reforges the covenant by pouring his own memories into the flame, restoring both realms as Corvane falls. POV: Sera, then Jonah dimly. Emotional beat: bittersweet grace—a man without a past wakes to a future, and Sera begins telling him who he was.
